annotation_source: Assistant visual inspection of source frames and the observed-pixel reconstruction, before viewing updated detector overlays
scope: Fifteen clearly visible reddish-brown priority-route holds; not a complete wall annotation or verified contact sequence
limitations: This is a small development audit, not independent expert ground truth. Two visually ambiguous lower features are excluded. Center coverage does not measure instance-mask IoU, false-positive rate or contact accuracy.
match_rule: One-to-one candidate assignment whose mask contains the annotated interior point within a fixed 3-pixel tolerance

annotation_correction.reason: Magnified source-crop inspection shows a route marker next to R13, not a climbing hold. Removed from every stage denominator; original draft preserved.
